headlines.title: Amazon Cargo Plane Overruns Runway in Miami, Killing at Least 5
headlines.description: At least five people were killed and several others injured when an Amazon Prime Air cargo plane overran a runway at Miami International Airport on Sunday. Officials said the aircraft struck multiple vehicles before stopping near a parking lot, triggering a ground stop and widespread flight disruptions. NBC’s George Solis reports and Tom Costello joins TODAY on the key questions federal investigators will be asking to determine what caused the crash.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy Case Ends in Mistrial: Will She Be Tried Again?
headlines.description: Lindsay Clancy’s future remains uncertain after a mistrial was declared Friday in her triple murder case. Now the district attorney is left to contemplate a retrial. NBC’s Valerie Castro reports and legal analyst Danny Cevallos joins TODAY with insight into what may come next.

headlines.title: King Charles confirms Harry and Meghan will not be working royals after U.K. return
headlines.description: Prince Harry and Meghan will not be working members of Britain’s royal family now they have returned to the U.K., a letter sent on behalf of King Charles said.

headlines.description: A trailer is out for “You Can See Everything,” a documentary directed by Nathan Fielder that focuses on Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes leading up to her imprisonment after she was convicted of fraud. Get a first look!

headlines.title: Family of 14-year-old found dead in singer D4vd’s Tesla seeks the death penalty
headlines.description: The family of Celeste Rivas Hernandez is calling for the singer D4vd to face the death penalty after a Los Angeles judge ordered him to stand trial in the killing of the 14-year-old.

headlines.title: Hurricane Lowell nears Hawaii, prompting warnings for 3 islands
headlines.description: Hurricane Lowell is expected to pass to the west of the Hawaiian islands of Kauai and Niihau. A hurricane warning is in effect for both, with a tropical storm warning for Oahu.

headlines.title: College volleyball players keep Wrigley Field crowd entertained during delays
headlines.description: More than 40,000 college volleyball fans left Chicago’s Wrigley Field Sunday night without getting to watch the Nebraska-Missouri match due to weather delays, but it was still a win with players doing their best to keep the crowd entertained — with a dance competition.

headlines.title: New Mexico Democrats push back over Trump posts about renaming state ‘New America’
headlines.description: New Mexico Democratic leaders are aggressively pushing back on President Donald Trump’s social media posts about renaming the state of New Mexico as “New America.”

headlines.description: A provocative and previously unannounced documentary from comedian Nathan Fielder and director Lance Oppenheim that features an intimate look at Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes and her family premiered Sunday night in a secrecy-shrouded screening at the Telluride Film Festival in Colorado.
